// A raw string literal: the file content has both quote kinds in it.
const checklistText = `# Plan

- [x] Read the current writer
  - handles escaped quotes
- [~] Patch the parser
- [ ] Update the tests
- [ ] Update the docs
`

func writeChecklist(t *testing.T, dir, body string) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "TODO.md")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644))
	return path
}

// The row trails the transcript so it sits just above the composer, where the
// eye already is. It used to lead, which put it above the fold where it was
// invisible until you scrolled up — and it drifted further away as the
// conversation grew.
func TestMapperChecklistRowTrailsTranscript(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.Checklist = transcript.NewChecklistSource(writeChecklist(t, dir, checklistText))

	entries, ids, dirty := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{
		Messages: []session.Message{{
			ID: "m1", Role: session.RoleAssistant, State: session.StateComplete,
			Content: []session.ContentBlock{{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "c1", Name: "read", Complete: true}},
		}},
		Tools: map[string]session.ToolRun{"c1": {
			ToolUseID: "c1", Name: "read", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "haiku.txt",
		}},
	})

	require.Len(t, entries, 2, "the tool row plus the checklist row")
	require.Len(t, ids, 2)
	assert.Equal(t, "tool-c1", ids[0], "session rows keep their order")
	assert.Equal(t, transcript.ChecklistSourceEntryID, ids[1], "the checklist trails")
	cl, ok := entries[1].(*block.ChecklistBlock)
	require.True(t, ok, "got %T", entries[1])
	assert.Contains(t, dirty, 1, "the trailing row is dirtied at its own index")

	done, open, _ := cl.Counts()
	assert.Equal(t, 1, done)
	assert.Equal(t, 2, open)
}

func TestMapperChecklistAbsentHidesRow(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.Checklist = transcript.NewChecklistSource(filepath.Join(dir, "nope.md"))
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{})
	assert.Empty(t, entries, "no task file, no row")
}

func TestMapperChecklistAppearsWhenFileIsCreated(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "TODO.md")
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.Checklist = transcript.NewChecklistSource(path)

	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{})
	assert.Empty(t, entries)

	// The agent creates the file mid-session; the row appears on the next sync.
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(checklistText), 0o644))
	// The first Sync stat-found nothing, so loaded is false and the next stat
	// is a change regardless of mtime granularity.
	time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("- [ ] first\n- [x] second\n"), 0o644))

	entries, ids, dirty := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{})
	require.Len(t, entries, 1)
	assert.Equal(t, transcript.ChecklistSourceEntryID, ids[0])
	assert.Contains(t, dirty, 0)
}

func TestMapperChecklistRefreshPicksEdits(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := writeChecklist(t, dir, checklistText)
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.Checklist = transcript.NewChecklistSource(path)

	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{})
	done, _, _ := entries[0].(*block.ChecklistBlock).Counts()
	assert.Equal(t, 1, done, "one ticked item in the fixture")

	time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("- [x] a\n- [x] b\n- [x] c\n"), 0o644))
	entries, _, dirty := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{})
	require.Len(t, entries, 1)
	done, _, _ = entries[0].(*block.ChecklistBlock).Counts()
	assert.Equal(t, 3, done, "the row re-read once the file changed")
	assert.Contains(t, dirty, 0, "and the entry is marked dirty so the height refreshes")
}

func TestMapperChecklistUserToggleWins(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := writeChecklist(t, dir, checklistText)
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.Checklist = transcript.NewChecklistSource(path)

	first, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{})
	// Auto-expand is off here, so the row starts collapsed and one Enter opens
	// it — the toggle path is what records the user's choice.
	assert.False(t, first[0].(*block.ChecklistBlock).Expanded)
	first[0].Handle(&components.EventContext{}, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyEnter})

	second, _, _ := m.Sync(first, []string{transcript.ChecklistSourceEntryID}, session.Snapshot{})
	assert.True(t, second[0].(*block.ChecklistBlock).Expanded, "the open sticks")

	// And so does a later collapse.
	second[0].Handle(&components.EventContext{}, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyEnter})
	third, _, _ := m.Sync(second, []string{transcript.ChecklistSourceEntryID}, session.Snapshot{})
	assert.False(t, third[0].(*block.ChecklistBlock).Expanded, "and the close sticks")
}

func TestMapperChecklistStalenessCountsEdits(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := writeChecklist(t, dir, checklistText)
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.Checklist = transcript.NewChecklistSource(path)

	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, session.Snapshot{
		Messages: []session.Message{{
			ID: "m1", Role: session.RoleAssistant, State: session.StateComplete,
			Content: []session.ContentBlock{
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "e1", Name: "edit", Complete: true},
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "r1", Name: "read", Complete: true},
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "e2", Name: "write", Complete: true},
			},
		}},
		Tools: map[string]session.ToolRun{
			"e1": {ToolUseID: "e1", Name: "edit", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "a.go"},
			"r1": {ToolUseID: "r1", Name: "read", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "b.go"},
			"e2": {ToolUseID: "e2", Name: "write", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "c.go"},
		},
	})
	// Three tool rows, then the trailing checklist row.
	cl := entries[3].(*block.ChecklistBlock)
	require.Len(t, entries, 4)
	assert.Equal(t, 2, cl.StaleFor, "edit and write count; the read does not")
}
package transcript_test

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components/block"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/session"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/tui/transcript"
)

func groupSnap() session.Snapshot {
	return session.Snapshot{
		Messages: []session.Message{{
			ID: "a1", Role: session.RoleAssistant, State: session.StateComplete,
			Content: []session.ContentBlock{
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "r1", Name: "read", Input: "haiku.txt", Complete: true},
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "g1", Name: "grep", Input: "cursor", Complete: true},
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "r2", Name: "read", Input: "main.go", Complete: true},
			},
		}},
		Tools: map[string]session.ToolRun{
			"r1": {ToolUseID: "r1", Name: "read", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "haiku.txt"},
			"g1": {ToolUseID: "g1", Name: "grep", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: `grep "cursor" in .`},
			"r2": {ToolUseID: "r2", Name: "read", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "main.go"},
		},
	}
}

func TestMapperRoutesReadGroup(t *testing.T) {
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	entries, ids, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, groupSnap())
	require.Len(t, entries, 1, "three reads are one row")
	assert.Equal(t, "tool-group-r1", ids[0])
	g, ok := entries[0].(*block.ReadGroupBlock)
	require.True(t, ok, "got %T", entries[0])
	assert.Equal(t, "Read 2 files, searched for 1 pattern", g.Detail)
	require.Len(t, g.Members(), 3)
	assert.Equal(t, `"cursor" in .`, g.Members()[1].Detail,
		"the leading verb is stripped so the row does not read grep grep")
}

func TestMapperReadGroupPatchesInPlace(t *testing.T) {
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	first, ids, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, groupSnap())
	require.Len(t, first, 1)

	// The last read finishes between syncs; the same widget must update rather
	// than rebuild, which would drop the row's scroll position.
	snap := groupSnap()
	running := snap.Tools["r2"]
	running.Status = session.ToolInProgress
	snap.Tools["r2"] = running
	second, _, dirty := m.Sync(first, ids, snap)
	require.Len(t, second, 1)
	assert.Same(t, first[0], second[0], "the row is patched, not replaced")
	assert.NotEmpty(t, dirty, "the change is dirty so the height refreshes")

	g := second[0].(*block.ReadGroupBlock)
	require.Len(t, g.Members(), 3, "members still resolve from the live snapshot")
	assert.Equal(t, "main.go", g.Members()[2].Detail)
}

func TestMapperErroredMemberSplitsGroup(t *testing.T) {
	// An error must never be folded into a count the user cannot act on, so a
	// member that failed re-enters the transcript as its own row.
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	snap := groupSnap()
	snap.Tools["r2"] = session.ToolRun{
		ToolUseID: "r2", Name: "read", Status: session.ToolError, Error: "no such file",
	}
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, snap)
	require.Len(t, entries, 2, "the failed read is its own row")

	group, ok := entries[0].(*block.ReadGroupBlock)
	require.True(t, ok, "got %T", entries[0])
	assert.Equal(t, 2, len(group.Members()), "only the survivors stay in the group")

	_, isRead := entries[1].(*block.ReadBlock)
	assert.True(t, isRead, "the failure renders as a normal read card")
}

func TestMapperReadGroupAutoExpand(t *testing.T) {
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.AutoExpand = true
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, groupSnap())
	assert.True(t, entries[0].(*block.ReadGroupBlock).Expanded,
		"the summary alone would hide the cards the user asked to see")
}

func TestMapperReadGroupCollapsedByDefault(t *testing.T) {
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, groupSnap())
	assert.False(t, entries[0].(*block.ReadGroupBlock).Expanded)
}

func TestMapperGroupMemberPrefersSummary(t *testing.T) {
	// A fetch member's status and size are the answer; its url is provenance.
	snap := session.Snapshot{
		Messages: []session.Message{{
			ID: "a1", Role: session.RoleAssistant, State: session.StateComplete,
			Content: []session.ContentBlock{
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "f1", Name: "fetch", Input: "a", Complete: true},
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "f2", Name: "fetch", Input: "b", Complete: true},
			},
		}},
		Tools: map[string]session.ToolRun{
			"f1": {
				ToolUseID: "f1", Name: "fetch", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "https://a.test/x",
				Summary: "200 OK · 12 KB · 0.4s · a.test",
			},
			"f2": {
				ToolUseID: "f2", Name: "fetch", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "https://b.test/y",
				Summary: "404 Not Found · 1 KB · 0.1s · b.test",
			},
		},
	}
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	m.AutoExpand = true
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, snap)
	g, ok := entries[0].(*block.ReadGroupBlock)
	require.True(t, ok, "got %T", entries[0])

	members := g.Members()
	require.Len(t, members, 2)
	assert.Equal(t, "200 OK · 12 KB · 0.4s · a.test", members[0].Summary)

	got := components.SurfaceText(g.Draw(components.DrawContext{
		Max: components.Size{Width: 74, Height: 20},
	}))
	assert.Contains(t, got, "fetch 200 OK · 12 KB · 0.4s")
	assert.Contains(t, got, "fetch 404 Not Found · 1 KB · 0.1s",
		"a non-200 member stays visible in the group")
	assert.NotContains(t, got, "https://a.test/x",
		"the url is provenance; the expansion still carries it in each member")
}
package transcript

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/pulseaiclub/xui"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components"
)

// Message-action mode: a cursor over the transcript that can copy any block.
//
// Claude Code binds shift+up to enter the mode, then j/k to move, Enter to act
// (expand a group, or edit a user message), c to copy, and Esc to leave. The
// shape is what matters rather than the letters: every block already computes
// CopyText, but without a cursor there is no keyboard path to it — only a mouse
// selection, which does not work over ssh or in a plain terminal.
type MessageActions struct {
	// Active reports whether the mode owns the keyboard. While inactive every
	// key falls through to the composer, so typing is never intercepted.
	Active bool

	cursor int
	pane   *TranscriptPane
}

// NewMessageActions builds cursor state bound to a pane.
func NewMessageActions(pane *TranscriptPane) *MessageActions {
	return &MessageActions{cursor: -1, pane: pane}
}

// Enter starts the mode, placing the cursor on the most recent entry: that is
// the block a user almost always wants, and it costs them zero keystrokes.
func (a *MessageActions) Enter() bool {
	if a == nil || a.pane == nil || len(a.pane.list.Entries) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	a.Active = true
	a.cursor = len(a.pane.list.Entries) - 1
	a.pane.list.Selected = a.cursor
	a.pane.list.ScrollToEntry(a.cursor)
	return true
}

// Exit leaves the mode and clears the highlight.
func (a *MessageActions) Exit() {
	if a == nil {
		return
	}
	a.Active = false
	a.cursor = -1
	if a.pane != nil {
		a.pane.list.Selected = -1
	}
}

// Move steps the cursor, clamping at both ends rather than wrapping — wrapping
// across a long transcript makes it easy to lose your place. Returns whether
// the cursor actually moved, so the caller can skip a redraw.
func (a *MessageActions) Move(delta int) bool {
	if a == nil || !a.Active || a.pane == nil {
		return false
	}
	n := len(a.pane.list.Entries)
	if n == 0 {
		return false
	}
	next := min(max(a.cursor+delta, 0), n-1)
	if next == a.cursor {
		return false
	}
	a.cursor = next
	a.pane.list.Selected = a.cursor
	a.pane.list.ScrollToEntry(a.cursor)
	return true
}

// Current returns the entry under the cursor, or nil.
func (a *MessageActions) Current() components.Widget {
	if a == nil || !a.Active || a.pane == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if a.cursor < 0 || a.cursor >= len(a.pane.list.Entries) {
		return nil
	}
	return a.pane.list.Entries[a.cursor]
}

// CopyText is the copy payload for the entry under the cursor. User messages
// keep their raw text rather than a re-rendered block, because that is what gets
// pasted back.
func (a *MessageActions) CopyText() string {
	w := a.Current()
	if w == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if ub, ok := w.(interface{ CopyText() string }); ok {
		if text := ub.CopyText(); strings.TrimSpace(text) != "" {
			return text
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// CursorIndex returns the 0-based entry index under the cursor, or -1 when the
// mode is inactive. Exposed for tests and for the footer hint.
func (a *MessageActions) CursorIndex() int {
	if a == nil || !a.Active {
		return -1
	}
	return a.cursor
}

// Position reports the cursor's 1-based position and the entry count, for the
// footer hint.
func (a *MessageActions) Position() string {
	if a == nil || !a.Active || a.pane == nil || a.cursor < 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", a.cursor+1, len(a.pane.list.Entries))
}

// ItemID returns the session item id under the cursor, which is what an edit
// request has to name. Empty when the cursor is not on a user message.
func (a *MessageActions) ItemID() string {
	w := a.Current()
	if w == nil {
		return ""
	}
	type ided interface{ ItemIDString() string }
	if iw, ok := w.(ided); ok {
		return iw.ItemIDString()
	}
	return ""
}

// Handle routes a key while the mode is active. It returns true when it consumed
// the key, so the composer never sees a keystroke meant for the cursor.
//
// The copy chord is accepted in two shapes because the reference binds a bare
// key once you are inside the mode: no modifier, just c.
func (a *MessageActions) Handle(ctx *components.EventContext, e xui.KeyEvent) bool {
	if a == nil || !a.Active || !e.Press {
		return false
	}
	switch e.Code {
	case xui.KeyEscape:
		a.Exit()
		return true
	case xui.KeyUp:
		return a.Move(-1)
	case xui.KeyDown:
		return a.Move(1)
	case xui.KeyRune:
		if e.Mods.Has(xui.ModCtrl) || e.Mods.Has(xui.ModAlt) {
			return false
		}
		switch e.Rune {
		case 'k', 'K':
			return a.Move(-1)
		case 'j', 'J':
			return a.Move(1)
		case 'c', 'C':
			a.copy()
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// copy copies the current entry, leaving the mode active so the user can copy
// several blocks in a row rather than re-entering for each.
func (a *MessageActions) copy() {
	if a.pane == nil {
		return
	}
	text := a.CopyText()
	if strings.TrimSpace(text) == "" {
		return
	}
	a.pane.CopyBlock(text)
}
package transcript_test

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/pulseaiclub/xui"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/session"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/tui/transcript"
)

// threeBlocks gives the pane three distinct copyable rows.
func threeBlocks() *transcript.TranscriptPane {
	pane := transcript.NewTranscriptPane(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, "A1 test")
	snap := session.Snapshot{
		Messages: []session.Message{
			{ID: "u1", Role: session.RoleUser, Text: "first prompt"},
			{
				ID: "a1", Role: session.RoleAssistant, State: session.StateComplete,
				Content: []session.ContentBlock{{
					Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "r1", Name: "read", Input: "haiku.txt", Complete: true,
				}},
			},
			{ID: "u2", Role: session.RoleUser, Text: "second prompt"},
		},
		Tools: map[string]session.ToolRun{"r1": {
			ToolUseID: "r1", Name: "read", Status: session.ToolDone, Detail: "haiku.txt",
		}},
	}
	pane.LoadReplay(snap)
	pane.Sync()
	return pane
}

func TestMessageActionsEnterStartsOnLatest(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	assert.False(t, a.Active)

	require.True(t, a.Enter(), "entering with entries present works")
	assert.True(t, a.Active)

	assert.NotEmpty(t, a.CopyText(), "and it has copyable text")
}

func TestMessageActionsEmptyPaneDoesNotEnter(t *testing.T) {
	pane := transcript.NewTranscriptPane(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, "A1 test")
	a := pane.Actions()
	assert.False(t, a.Enter(), "an empty transcript has nothing to point at")
	assert.False(t, a.Active)
}

func TestMessageActionsMoveClamps(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())

	// Start at 2 (last). Up to 1, then 0, then stop — no wraparound.
	assert.True(t, a.Move(-1))
	assert.Equal(t, 1, a.CursorIndex())
	assert.True(t, a.Move(-1))
	assert.Equal(t, 0, a.CursorIndex())
	assert.False(t, a.Move(-1), "clamped at the top rather than wrapping")
	assert.Equal(t, 0, a.CursorIndex())

	assert.True(t, a.Move(1))
	assert.Equal(t, 1, a.CursorIndex())
}

func TestMessageActionsPosition(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	assert.Empty(t, a.Position(), "no position outside the mode")

	require.True(t, a.Enter())
	assert.Equal(t, "3/3", a.Position())
	require.True(t, a.Move(-1))
	assert.Equal(t, "2/3", a.Position())
}

func TestMessageActionsEscapeExits(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())

	ctx := &components.EventContext{}
	consumed := a.Handle(ctx, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyEscape})
	assert.True(t, consumed)
	assert.False(t, a.Active, "escape leaves the mode")
	assert.Equal(t, -1, a.CursorIndex())
	assert.Equal(t, -1, pane.SelectedEntryForTest(), "and clears the highlight")
}

func TestMessageActionsKeyRouting(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())

	ctx := &components.EventContext{}
	assert.True(t, a.Handle(ctx, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyUp}))
	assert.Equal(t, 1, a.CursorIndex())
	assert.True(t, a.Handle(ctx, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyRune, Rune: 'k'}))
	assert.Equal(t, 0, a.CursorIndex())
	assert.True(t, a.Handle(ctx, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyRune, Rune: 'j'}))
	assert.Equal(t, 1, a.CursorIndex())
}

func TestMessageActionsCopyTextPerBlock(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())

	// Cursor lands on the last user message.
	assert.Equal(t, "second prompt", a.CopyText())

	require.True(t, a.Move(-1))
	assert.NotEmpty(t, a.CopyText(), "the read row copies its own text")
}

func TestMessageActionsIgnoresKeysWhileInactive(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	ctx := &components.EventContext{}
	// A bare 'c' with no modifiers must fall through to the composer while the
	// mode is off, or typing would be impossible.
	assert.False(t, a.Handle(ctx, xui.KeyEvent{Press: true, Code: xui.KeyRune, Rune: 'c'}))
	assert.False(t, a.Active)
}

func TestMessageActionsModifiersFallThrough(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())

	ctx := &components.EventContext{}
	// Ctrl+C is the interrupt chord, never a copy from the cursor.
	assert.False(t, a.Handle(ctx, xui.KeyEvent{
		Press: true, Code: xui.KeyRune, Rune: 'c', Mods: xui.ModCtrl,
	}))
}

func TestMessageActionsCursorSurvivesSync(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())
	require.True(t, a.Move(-1))

	// An unrelated sync must not silently retarget the cursor onto a different
	// block; the ids are unchanged, so the cursor stays exactly where it was.
	before := a.CursorIndex()
	pane.Sync()
	assert.Equal(t, before, a.CursorIndex(), "a no-op sync keeps the cursor put")
}

func TestMessageActionsEntryIDIsExposed(t *testing.T) {
	pane := threeBlocks()
	a := pane.Actions()
	require.True(t, a.Enter())
	assert.NotEmpty(t, a.ItemID(), "the cursor names the item, which an edit needs")
}
package transcript_test

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components/block"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/session"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/tui/transcript"
)

func summarySnap() session.Snapshot {
	return session.Snapshot{
		Messages: []session.Message{{
			ID: "a1", Role: session.RoleAssistant, State: session.StateComplete,
			Content: []session.ContentBlock{
				{Type: session.BlockToolUse, ID: "f1", Name: "fetch", Input: "u", Complete: true},
			},
		}},
		Tools: map[string]session.ToolRun{
			"f1": {
				ToolUseID: "f1", Name: "fetch", Status: session.ToolDone,
				Detail:  "https://example.com/docs",
				Summary: "200 OK · 42.5 KB · 1.2s · example.com",
				Output:  "Status: 200 OK",
			},
		},
	}
}

func TestMapperToolBlockShowsSummary(t *testing.T) {
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, summarySnap())
	require.Len(t, entries, 1)
	tb, ok := entries[0].(*block.ToolBlock)
	require.True(t, ok, "got %T", entries[0])

	got := components.SurfaceText(tb.Draw(components.DrawContext{
		Max: components.Size{Width: 90, Height: 20},
	}))
	assert.Contains(t, got, "200 OK · 42.5 KB · 1.2s",
		"the tool's own summary line, not a generic line count")
	assert.NotContains(t, got, "(1 line)",
		"the fallback line count yields to a real summary")
	assert.Contains(t, got, "https://example.com/docs", "the identity is untouched")
}

func TestMapperToolBlockFallsBackToLineCount(t *testing.T) {
	snap := summarySnap()
	snap.Tools["f1"] = session.ToolRun{
		ToolUseID: "f1", Name: "fetch", Status: session.ToolDone,
		Detail: "https://example.com", Output: "a\nb\nc",
	}
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	entries, _, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, snap)
	tb := entries[0].(*block.ToolBlock)
	got := components.SurfaceText(tb.Draw(components.DrawContext{
		Max: components.Size{Width: 90, Height: 20},
	}))
	assert.Contains(t, got, "(3 lines)", "tools without a summary keep the old behavior")
}

func TestMapperToolBlockSummarySurvivesPatch(t *testing.T) {
	m := transcript.NewMapper(components.DefaultTheme(), nil, nil)
	first, ids, _ := m.Sync(nil, nil, summarySnap())
	require.Len(t, first, 1)

	second, _, dirty := m.Sync(first, ids, summarySnap())
	require.Len(t, second, 1)
	assert.Same(t, first[0], second[0], "patched, not rebuilt")
	assert.Empty(t, dirty, "an unchanged summary is not dirty")
}
package transcript

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components/block"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/components/status"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/session"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/todo"
	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/tools"
)

// Mapper converts session.Snapshot items into transcript widgets.
// It owns expand-state and has no dependency on Editor / xui / agent.
type Mapper struct {
	theme        components.Theme
	spinner      *status.Spinner
	expanded     map[string]bool
	onInvalidate func() // e.g. MessageList.InvalidateHeights
	// Children returns nested sub-agent tool rows for a parent tool_use id.
	Children func(parentToolUseID string) []block.ChildTool
	// ChildrenByJob returns nested rows keyed by job id (fallback for spawn/task).
	ChildrenByJob func(jobID string) []block.ChildTool

	// AutoExpand opens file-editing rows, so diffs are visible without a
	// keypress. Read/grep and bash rows keep their compact collapsed forms
	// either way — see autoExpandFor for the policy. A row the user collapses
	// still wins, because m.expanded records the user's choice once they touch it.
	AutoExpand bool

	// snap is the last snapshot handed to Sync, read when a collapsed group's
	// expansion resolves its member rows. Never mutated here.
	snap session.Snapshot

	// Checklist is the project task file rendered as a live progress row. Nil
	// disables the row entirely, which is the default for callers that have no
	// project root (tests, the web surface).
	Checklist *ChecklistSource
}

// ChecklistSource polls a task file and caches its parse. The zero value is
// inert; use NewChecklistSource.
//
// The row is synthesized by the Mapper rather than projected from the session,
// because a checklist is workspace state, not conversation content: it has to
// exist before the first message and survive a replay. File identity is
// (mtime, size) rather than content, so a frame that changes nothing does no
// work beyond one stat.
type ChecklistSource struct {
	// Path is the task file to read.
	Path string
	// StaleFor counts file-editing tool rows since the checklist last moved.
	// Non-zero renders a staleness warning on the row.
	StaleFor int

	lastMod   time.Time
	lastSize  int64
	items     []todo.Item
	changedAt time.Time
	loaded    bool
}

// ChecklistSourceEntryID is the synthetic item id of the checklist row.
const ChecklistSourceEntryID = "checklist"

// NewMapper builds a Mapper with the given theme, spinner, and invalidation callback.
func NewMapper(theme components.Theme, spinner *status.Spinner, onInvalidate func()) *Mapper {
	return &Mapper{
		theme:        theme,
		spinner:      spinner,
		expanded:     make(map[string]bool),
		onInvalidate: onInvalidate,
	}
}

// SetTheme updates the theme used for newly built and patched widgets.
func (m *Mapper) SetTheme(theme components.Theme) {
	if m != nil {
		m.theme = theme
	}
}

// Sync rebuilds the widget list from snap, reusing widgets when patchable.
// dirty lists new-entry indices whose height-relevant content changed (or are new).
func (m *Mapper) Sync(
	entries []components.Widget,
	listIDs []string,
	snap session.Snapshot,
) (newEntries []components.Widget, newIDs []string, dirty []int) {
	m.snap = snap
	items := session.Project(snap)
	n := len(items)
	byID := make(map[string]int, len(entries))
	for i, w := range entries {
		id := entryID(listIDs, i)
		if id == "" {
			continue
		}
		byID[id] = i
		switch b := w.(type) {
		case *block.ThinkingBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		case *block.ToolBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		case *block.ReadBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		case *block.ReadGroupBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		case *block.DiffBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		case *block.BashBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		case *block.AgentBlock:
			m.expanded[id] = b.Expanded
		}
	}

	// The checklist row is not part of the projected items: it trails the
	// transcript when a task file exists. It answers "what am I doing" at the
	// point just above the composer, where the eye already is — leading the list
	// put it above the fold, where it was invisible until you scrolled up, and
	// it drifted further away as the conversation grew.
	newEntries = make([]components.Widget, 0, n+1)
	newIDs = make([]string, 0, n+1)
	// The staleness count comes from the projected rows, so it has to be
	// computed before the widget is built — it is part of what the row draws.
	// refresh() runs first because it is what flips loaded on the very first
	// sync, when the file already exists before the first frame.
	if m.Checklist != nil && m.Checklist.Path != "" {
		m.Checklist.refresh()
		m.Checklist.StaleFor = countEditTools(items)
	}
	for _, it := range items {
		idx := len(newEntries)
		newIDs = append(newIDs, it.ID)
		if oldIdx, ok := byID[it.ID]; ok {
			if ok, changed := m.patchItem(entries[oldIdx], it); ok {
				newEntries = append(newEntries, entries[oldIdx])
				if changed {
					dirty = append(dirty, idx)
				}
				continue
			}
		}
		newEntries = append(newEntries, m.widgetFor(it))
		dirty = append(dirty, idx)
	}
	if cl := m.checklistWidget(); cl != nil {
		// The row is rebuilt every frame because a file edit can change it
		// without any session event. Marking it dirty only when the content
		// actually moved keeps the height cache stable: a frame where the file
		// is untouched costs one stat and no relayout.
		// byID is keyed by entry id, and its index was captured before anything
		// was appended — so a present checklist resolves to whichever entry
		// previously held the id, not blindly to entries[0].
		prevIdx, seen := byID[ChecklistSourceEntryID]
		if !seen || !checklistEqual(entries[prevIdx], cl) {
			dirty = append(dirty, len(newEntries))
		}
		newEntries = append(newEntries, cl)
		newIDs = append(newIDs, ChecklistSourceEntryID)
	}
	return newEntries, newIDs, dirty
}

func entryID(listIDs []string, i int) string {
	if i >= 0 && i < len(listIDs) {
		return listIDs[i]
	}
	return ""
}

func (m *Mapper) patchItem(w components.Widget, it session.Item) (ok, dirty bool) {
	switch it.Kind {
	case session.ItemUser:
		u, ok := w.(*block.UserBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		dirty = u.Text != it.Text || u.ItemID != it.ID
		u.Text = it.Text
		u.ItemID = it.ID
		u.Theme = m.theme
		return true, dirty
	case session.ItemAssistant:
		a, ok := w.(*block.AssistantBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		dirty = a.Text != it.Text || a.State != it.State
		a.Text = it.Text
		a.State = it.State
		a.Theme = m.theme
		return true, dirty
	case session.ItemThinking:
		t, ok := w.(*block.ThinkingBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		prevExp := t.Expanded
		dirty = t.Text != it.Thinking || t.Streaming != it.Streaming || t.Interrupted != it.Interrupted
		t.Text = it.Thinking
		t.Streaming = it.Streaming
		t.Interrupted = it.Interrupted
		t.Theme = m.theme
		t.Spinner = m.spinner
		if exp, ok := m.expanded[it.ID]; ok {
			t.Expanded = exp
		}
		if t.Expanded != prevExp {
			dirty = true
		}
		return true, dirty
	case session.ItemCompaction:
		c, ok := w.(*block.CompactionBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		c.Theme = m.theme
		dirty := c.TokensBefore != it.TokensBefore
		c.TokensBefore = it.TokensBefore
		return true, dirty
	case session.ItemTool:
		return m.patchTool(w, it)
	}
	return false, false
}

func (m *Mapper) patchTool(w components.Widget, it session.Item) (ok, dirty bool) {
	run := it.ToolRun
	name := strings.ToLower(run.Name)
	if name == "bash" {
		b, ok := w.(*block.BashBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		st := uiToolStatus(run.Status)
		prevExp := b.Expanded
		dirty = b.Command != run.Detail || b.Output != run.Output || b.Status != st || b.ExitCode != run.ExitCode
		b.Command = run.Detail
		b.Output = run.Output
		b.Status = st
		b.ExitCode = run.ExitCode
		b.Theme = m.theme
		nextExp := m.autoExpandFor(it.ID, run.Expanded, run)
		b.Expanded = nextExp
		if b.Expanded != prevExp {
			dirty = true
		}
		return true, dirty
	}
	if isAgentTreeTool(name) {
		a, ok := w.(*block.AgentBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		prev := agentHeightSnap{
			Name:     a.Name,
			Detail:   a.Detail,
			Status:   a.Status,
			Error:    a.Error,
			Summary:  a.Summary,
			Expanded: a.Expanded,
			Children: a.Children,
			Activity: a.Activity,
		}
		m.fillAgentBlock(a, it)
		// Activity is in the dirty check because it is the live header text:
		// without it a sub-agent that moved from grep to read would keep
		// showing the stale tool in an already-mounted row.
		dirty = prev.Name != a.Name || prev.Detail != a.Detail || prev.Status != a.Status ||
			prev.Error != a.Error || prev.Summary != a.Summary || prev.Expanded != a.Expanded ||
			prev.Activity != a.Activity ||
			!childToolsEqual(prev.Children, a.Children)
		return true, dirty
	}
	if isReadGroupTool(name) {
		g, ok := w.(*block.ReadGroupBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		prevDetail, prevStatus, prevExp, prevHint := g.Detail, g.Status, g.Expanded, g.Hint
		prevMembers := g.Members()
		g.Detail = run.Detail
		g.Status = uiToolStatus(run.Status)
		g.Hint = run.Group.Hint
		g.Theme = m.theme
		g.Spinner = m.spinner
		nextExp := m.autoExpandFor(it.ID, run.Expanded, run)
		g.Expanded = nextExp
		// Members are resolved at draw time, so their state can change without
		// any field on the group itself moving — an expanded row would keep
		// showing a stale "running" member until something else dirtied it.
		return true, prevDetail != g.Detail || prevStatus != g.Status ||
			prevExp != nextExp || prevHint != g.Hint ||
			!childToolsEqual(prevMembers, g.Members())
	}
	if isReadTool(name) {
		r, ok := w.(*block.ReadBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		prevName, prevPath, prevDetail, prevBody, prevErr, prevExp := r.Name, r.Path, r.Detail, r.Body, r.Error, r.Expanded
		r.Name = run.Name
		r.Path, r.Detail = readRowTarget(run)
		r.Body = stripReadHeader(run.Output)
		r.Error = run.Error
		r.Status = uiToolStatus(run.Status)
		r.Theme = m.theme
		r.Spinner = m.spinner
		nextExp := m.autoExpandFor(it.ID, run.Expanded, run)
		r.Expanded = nextExp
		return true, prevName != r.Name || prevPath != r.Path || prevDetail != r.Detail ||
			prevBody != r.Body || prevErr != r.Error || nextExp != prevExp
	}
	if isEditTool(name) {
		d, ok := w.(*block.DiffBlock)
		if !ok {
			return false, false
		}
		prevPath, prevDiff, prevErr, prevExp := d.Path, d.Diff, d.Error, d.Expanded
		d.Path, d.Diff, d.Error = m.editToolFields(it)
		d.Status = uiToolStatus(run.Status)
		d.Theme = m.theme
		d.Spinner = m.spinner
		nextExp := m.autoExpandFor(it.ID, run.Expanded, run)
		d.Expanded = nextExp
		return true, prevPath != d.Path || prevDiff != d.Diff || prevErr != d.Error || nextExp != prevExp
	}
	t, ok := w.(*block.ToolBlock)
	if !ok {
		return false, false
	}
	st := uiToolStatus(run.Status)
	prevExp := t.Expanded
	dirty = t.Name != run.Name || t.Detail != run.Detail || t.Summary != run.Summary ||
		t.Output != run.Output || t.Error != run.Error || t.Status != st
	t.Name = run.Name
	t.Detail = run.Detail
	t.Summary = run.Summary
	t.Output = run.Output
	t.Error = run.Error
	t.Status = st
	t.Theme = m.theme
	t.Spinner = m.spinner
	if exp, ok := m.expanded[it.ID]; ok {
		t.Expanded = exp
	} else if run.Expanded {
		t.Expanded = true
	} else if t.Status == status.ToolRunning && t.Output != "" {
		t.Expanded = true
	}
	if t.Expanded != prevExp {
		dirty = true
	}
	return true, dirty
}

type agentHeightSnap struct {
	Name     string
	Detail   string
	Status   status.ToolStatus
	Error    string
	Summary  string
	Expanded bool
	Children []block.ChildTool
	Activity string
}

func childToolsEqual(a, b []block.ChildTool) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range a {
		if a[i] != b[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (m *Mapper) widgetFor(it session.Item) components.Widget {
	exp := m.expanded[it.ID]
	id := it.ID
	switch it.Kind {
	case session.ItemUser:
		return &block.UserBlock{Text: it.Text, Theme: m.theme, ItemID: it.ID}
	case session.ItemThinking:
		return &block.ThinkingBlock{
			Text:        it.Thinking,
			Streaming:   it.Streaming,
			Interrupted: it.Interrupted,
			Expanded:    exp || it.Streaming,
			Theme:       m.theme,
			Spinner:     m.spinner,
			OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
				m.expanded[id] = expanded
				if m.onInvalidate != nil {
					m.onInvalidate()
				}
			},
		}
	case session.ItemCompaction:
		return &block.CompactionBlock{Theme: m.theme, TokensBefore: it.TokensBefore}
	case session.ItemTool:
		return m.toolWidget(it, exp)
	default:
		return &block.AssistantBlock{Text: it.Text, State: it.State, Theme: m.theme}
	}
}

// autoExpandFor decides whether a fresh tool row starts open.
//
// The user's own toggle always wins (recorded in m.expanded once they touch a
// row). After that the policy is per tool family:
//
//   - read / grep start closed as a one-line summary, even with auto-expand on.
//     They are the highest-volume, least-urgent rows; a 30-file exploration is
//     30 cards of file content otherwise.
//   - bash starts closed too, but a closed bash row still renders a tail
//     preview of its output (BashCollapsedTailLines) — closing it is about
//     bounding volume, not hiding the outcome.
//   - write / edit start open with auto-expand: a diff is the one thing that
//     must not be missed.
//   - a row that streams output opens as it arrives, so running progress is
//     visible without a keypress.
func (m *Mapper) autoExpandFor(id string, exp bool, run session.ToolRun) bool {
	if _, touched := m.expanded[id]; touched {
		return m.expanded[id]
	}
	if exp || run.Local || run.Expanded {
		return true
	}
	if !m.AutoExpand {
		return run.Status == session.ToolInProgress && run.Output != ""
	}
	// Reads and bash keep their own compact forms under auto-expand: opening
	// them is how a transcript becomes a wall of file contents and logs.
	return !collapsesUnderAutoExpand(run.Name)
}

// collapsesUnderAutoExpand names the rows that keep a bounded collapsed form
// even when auto_expand_tool_output is on. A collapsed read row is a one-line
// summary; a collapsed bash row still shows a tail of its output, so closing
// them costs no information the user asked to see.
func collapsesUnderAutoExpand(name string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(name) {
	case "read", "grep", "bash":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (m *Mapper) toolWidget(it session.Item, exp bool) components.Widget {
	run := it.ToolRun
	autoExp := m.autoExpandFor(it.ID, exp, run)
	id := it.ID
	if strings.EqualFold(run.Name, "bash") {
		return &block.BashBlock{
			Command:  run.Detail,
			Output:   run.Output,
			Status:   uiToolStatus(run.Status),
			ExitCode: run.ExitCode,
			Expanded: autoExp,
			Theme:    m.theme,
			OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
				m.expanded[id] = expanded
				if m.onInvalidate != nil {
					m.onInvalidate()
				}
			},
		}
	}
	if isAgentTreeTool(run.Name) {
		a := &block.AgentBlock{
			Theme:   m.theme,
			Spinner: m.spinner,
			OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
				m.expanded[id] = expanded
				if m.onInvalidate != nil {
					m.onInvalidate()
				}
			},
		}
		m.fillAgentBlock(a, it)
		return a
	}
	if isReadGroupTool(run.Name) {
		return &block.ReadGroupBlock{
			Detail:   run.Detail,
			Hint:     run.Group.Hint,
			Status:   uiToolStatus(run.Status),
			Expanded: autoExp,
			Theme:    m.theme,
			Spinner:  m.spinner,
			// Resolves against the mapper's latest snapshot on every draw, so a
			// member arriving after the row was built still shows up. The item
			// id is captured, not the run itself: capturing the run would freeze
			// the group's members at creation time.
			Members: func() []block.ChildTool {
				if run.Group == nil {
					return nil
				}
				return m.groupMembersFrom(it.ID)
			},
			OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
				m.expanded[id] = expanded
				if m.onInvalidate != nil {
					m.onInvalidate()
				}
			},
		}
	}
	if isReadTool(run.Name) {
		path, detail := readRowTarget(run)
		return &block.ReadBlock{
			Name:     run.Name,
			Path:     path,
			Detail:   detail,
			Body:     stripReadHeader(run.Output),
			Error:    run.Error,
			Status:   uiToolStatus(run.Status),
			Expanded: autoExp,
			Theme:    m.theme,
			Spinner:  m.spinner,
			OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
				m.expanded[id] = expanded
				if m.onInvalidate != nil {
					m.onInvalidate()
				}
			},
		}
	}
	if isEditTool(run.Name) {
		path, diff, errText := m.editToolFields(it)
		return &block.DiffBlock{
			Path:     path,
			Diff:     diff,
			Error:    errText,
			Status:   uiToolStatus(run.Status),
			Expanded: autoExp,
			Theme:    m.theme,
			Spinner:  m.spinner,
			OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
				m.expanded[id] = expanded
				if m.onInvalidate != nil {
					m.onInvalidate()
				}
			},
		}
	}
	return &block.ToolBlock{
		Name:     run.Name,
		Detail:   run.Detail,
		Summary:  run.Summary,
		Output:   run.Output,
		Error:    run.Error,
		Status:   uiToolStatus(run.Status),
		Expanded: autoExp,
		Theme:    m.theme,
		Spinner:  m.spinner,
		OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
			m.expanded[id] = expanded
			if m.onInvalidate != nil {
				m.onInvalidate()
			}
		},
	}
}

func isAgentTreeTool(name string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(name) {
	case "agent_spawn", "agent_wait":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// isEditTool reports whether name is a file-editing tool whose output is a
// unified diff. These rows render as a DiffBlock so the change is visible
// without expanding, the way Claude Code shows edits.
func isEditTool(name string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(name) {
	case "write", "edit":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// isReadTool reports whether name is a file-reading tool whose output is
// numbered lines. These rows render as a ReadBlock, the same card shape as
// DiffBlock minus the +/- gutter.
func isReadTool(name string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(name) {
	case "read", "grep":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// stripLeadingVerb removes a leading tool name from an arg-derived phrase.
func stripLeadingVerb(detail, name string) string {
	detail = strings.TrimSpace(detail)
	if name == "" || detail == "" {
		return detail
	}
	lower := strings.ToLower(detail)
	prefix := strings.ToLower(name)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(lower, prefix) {
		return detail
	}
	rest := strings.TrimSpace(detail[len(prefix):])
	if rest == "" {
		return detail
	}
	// Only strip a whole-word match, so "grep" does not eat "grepfile".
	if isWordBoundary(rest[0]) {
		return rest
	}
	return detail
}

// isWordBoundary reports whether r starts a new word rather than continuing
// the one before it.
func isWordBoundary(r byte) bool {
	switch {
	case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
		return false
	default:
		return true
	}
}

// isReadGroupTool identifies the collapsed run of read-only calls.
func isReadGroupTool(name string) bool {
	return strings.EqualFold(name, "read_group")
}

// readRowTarget splits a read/grep run into the path shown by CopyText and the
// arg-derived phrase that identifies the search. DetailFromArgs gives grep its
// pattern phrase; once the run finishes it leaves Detail untouched (the match
// count lives in the row stat), so the phrase survives to the transcript.
func readRowTarget(run session.ToolRun) (path, detail string) {
	detail = strings.TrimSpace(run.Detail)
	detail = strings.TrimPrefix(detail, "@file ")
	// A bare path is both the path and the target.
	if !strings.ContainsAny(detail, " \"") {
		return detail, ""
	}
	return "", detail
}

// stripReadHeader drops the leading "@file path" line a read row carries. The
// path is already the card header, so repeating it costs a row on a narrow
// terminal. Other leading prose (grep's notices) is kept.
func stripReadHeader(body string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
	for i, ln := range lines {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ln)
		if trimmed == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "@file ") {
			rest := append(append([]string(nil), lines[:i]...), lines[i+1:]...)
			return strings.TrimLeft(strings.Join(rest, "\n"), "\n")
		}
		return body
	}
	return body
}

func (m *Mapper) fillAgentBlock(a *block.AgentBlock, it session.Item) {
	run := it.ToolRun
	a.Name = run.Name
	a.Detail = run.Detail
	a.Status = uiToolStatus(run.Status)
	a.Theme = m.theme
	a.Spinner = m.spinner
	a.Error = run.Error

	parsed := tools.ParseAgentResult(run.Output)
	if sum := parsed.RenderableSummary(); sum != "" {
		a.Summary = sum
	} else {
		a.Summary = ""
	}

	// agent_wait: summary only — the live tree already lives on agent_spawn.
	// agent_spawn: nested child tools from SubagentStore.
	a.Children = nil
	a.Activity = ""
	if !strings.EqualFold(run.Name, "agent_wait") && m.Children != nil {
		a.Children = m.Children(run.ToolUseID)
		if len(a.Children) == 0 && parsed.JobID != "" && m.ChildrenByJob != nil {
			a.Children = m.ChildrenByJob(parsed.JobID)
		}
	}
	// The header names the child currently in flight. Children arrive in
	// completion order, so the last non-terminal one is the live one; when all
	// have finished the last child is still the most recent thing it did.
	a.Activity = block.LastRunningChild(a.Children)

	if exp, ok := m.expanded[it.ID]; ok {
		a.Expanded = exp
	} else if a.Status == status.ToolRunning || len(a.Children) > 0 || a.Summary != "" {
		a.Expanded = true
	}
}

// groupMembersFrom resolves a collapsed group's member rows from the live
// snapshot. It re-projects the item so it works from the row's id alone, which
// is all the widget closure carries.
func (m *Mapper) groupMembersFrom(itemID string) []block.ChildTool {
	group := m.findGroup(itemID)
	if group == nil || len(group.Members) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]block.ChildTool, 0, len(group.Members))
	for _, id := range group.Members {
		member := m.memberRun(id)
		if member.Name == "" {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, block.ChildTool{
			Name:    member.Name,
			Detail:  stripLeadingVerb(member.Detail, member.Name),
			Summary: member.Summary,
			Status:  uiToolStatus(member.Status),
		})
	}
	return out
}

// findGroup locates the group for a row id in the current snapshot. A missing
// group returns nil so a stale widget renders as an empty row rather than
// panicking.
func (m *Mapper) findGroup(itemID string) *session.ToolGroup {
	for _, it := range session.Project(m.snap) {
		if it.ID == itemID && it.ToolRun.Group != nil {
			return it.ToolRun.Group
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// memberRun finds one member's ToolRun. It is passed the group's own item so a
// caller without the snapshot can still resolve live state through the mapper's
// cached snapshot; the session map is the authority.
func (m *Mapper) memberRun(id string) session.ToolRun {
	run, ok := m.snap.Tools[id]
	if !ok {
		return session.ToolRun{}
	}
	return run
}

// editToolFields extracts the display path and unified diff for a file-editing
// tool row. The write/edit tools already embed the diff in their output, so
// nothing has to be recomputed here — the row only needs to drop the duplicated
// file header and pick the right source when the run failed.
func (*Mapper) editToolFields(it session.Item) (path, diff, errText string) {
	run := it.ToolRun
	path = run.Detail
	errText = run.Error
	if run.Error != "" && strings.TrimSpace(run.Output) == "" {
		// A failed edit reports no diff; the error text carries the reason.
		return path, "", errText
	}
	return path, stripDiffFileHeaders(run.Output), errText
}

// stripDiffFileHeaders removes the ---/+++ header pair from a tool's output.
// DiffBlock already shows the path, so repeating a/ and b/ prefixes wastes two
// lines of a narrow terminal.
func stripDiffFileHeaders(diff string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(diff, "\n")
	out := lines[:0]
	for _, ln := range lines {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ln)
		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "--- a/") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "+++ b/") {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, ln)
	}
	return strings.TrimRight(strings.Join(out, "\n"), "\n")
}

func uiToolStatus(s session.ToolStatus) status.ToolStatus {
	switch s {
	case session.ToolDone:
		return status.ToolDone
	case session.ToolError:
		return status.ToolError
	case session.ToolCancelled:
		return status.ToolCancelled
	case session.ToolRejected:
		return status.ToolRejected
	case session.ToolQueued:
		return status.ToolQueued
	default:
		return status.ToolRunning
	}
}

// checklistWidget returns the checklist row, or nil when there is nothing to
// show. The file is re-read only when its stat result changed.
func (m *Mapper) checklistWidget() *block.ChecklistBlock {
	if m.Checklist == nil || m.Checklist.Path == "" {
		return nil
	}
	m.Checklist.refresh()
	if !m.Checklist.loaded {
		return nil
	}
	exp, touched := m.expanded[ChecklistSourceEntryID]
	if !touched {
		exp = m.AutoExpand
	}
	return &block.ChecklistBlock{
		Path:     m.Checklist.Path,
		Items:    m.Checklist.items,
		Expanded: exp,
		StaleFor: m.Checklist.StaleFor,
		Theme:    m.theme,
		OnToggle: func(expanded bool) {
			m.expanded[ChecklistSourceEntryID] = expanded
			if m.onInvalidate != nil {
				m.onInvalidate()
			}
		},
	}
}

// NewChecklistSource builds a source for a task file that may not exist yet.
// The first successful stat wins, so creating the file mid-session starts the
// row without a restart.
func NewChecklistSource(path string) *ChecklistSource {
	return &ChecklistSource{Path: path}
}

// refresh stats the file and re-parses only when it changed.
//
// mtime+size is deliberately coarse: an agent that rewrites identical content
// with the same size inside the mtime tick is indistinguishable, and re-reading
// every frame to catch that would burn IO for no visible gain.
func (c *ChecklistSource) refresh() {
	info, err := os.Stat(c.Path)
	if err != nil {
		// Absent is the normal state before the agent writes anything, and it
		// hides the row rather than showing an empty one.
		c.loaded = false
		c.items = nil
		return
	}
	if c.loaded && info.ModTime().Equal(c.lastMod) && info.Size() == c.lastSize {
		return
	}
	f, err := todo.Parse(c.Path)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	moved := !c.loaded || !equalItems(c.items, f.Items)
	c.items = f.Items
	c.lastMod = f.ModTime
	c.lastSize = f.Size
	c.loaded = true
	if moved {
		c.changedAt = time.Now()
		c.StaleFor = 0
	}
}

// countEditTools counts succeeded file-editing rows, which is the staleness
// signal for the checklist: a list the agent stopped updating while the code
// kept changing is lying, and the row says so instead of pretending.
func countEditTools(items []session.Item) int {
	n := 0
	for _, it := range items {
		if it.Kind != session.ItemTool {
			continue
		}
		if !isEditTool(it.ToolRun.Name) {
			continue
		}
		if it.ToolRun.Status == session.ToolDone || it.ToolRun.Status == session.ToolRejected {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// checklistEqual reports whether two checklist rows draw the same thing. Index
// 0 is assumed to be the checklist row when byID says it is present.
func checklistEqual(w components.Widget, cl *block.ChecklistBlock) bool {
	prev, ok := w.(*block.ChecklistBlock)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	if prev.Path != cl.Path || prev.Expanded != cl.Expanded || prev.StaleFor != cl.StaleFor {
		return false
	}
	if len(prev.Items) != len(cl.Items) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range prev.Items {
		if prev.Items[i] != cl.Items[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func equalItems(a, b []todo.Item) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range a {
		if a[i] != b[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// textSel tracks drag selection over the transcript.
// Coordinates are content-space (relative to MessageList content origin),
// so the highlight stays on the selected text when the list scrolls.
type textSel struct {
	pending  bool
	dragging bool
	active   bool
	ax, ay   int
	ex, ey   int
}

func (s *textSel) clear() {
	*s = textSel{}
}

// TranscriptPane owns session snapshot, transcript widgets, and list interaction.
type TranscriptPane struct {
	theme components.Theme

	list      msglist.MessageList
	listIDs   []string
	snap      session.Snapshot
	mapper    *Mapper
	subagents *SubagentStore
	welcome   splash.Screen
	startedAt time.Time

	sel textSel
	// actions is the keyboard cursor over the transcript (copy / edit a block).
	actions      *MessageActions
	listH        int
	lastListSurf components.Surface

	onUsage func(session.TokenUsage)
	copyFn  func(text string) bool
	bus     *controller.Bus
}

// NewTranscriptPane builds an empty transcript view.
func NewTranscriptPane(theme components.Theme, spin *status.Spinner, brand string) *TranscriptPane {
	t := &TranscriptPane{
		theme: theme,
		list: msglist.MessageList{
			Theme:    theme,
			Selected: -1,
		},
		welcome: splash.Screen{
			Sphere: &splash.Sphere{Fast: true},
			Theme:  theme,
			Brand:  brand,
		},
		startedAt: time.Now(),
		subagents: NewSubagentStore(),
	}
	t.mapper = NewMapper(theme, spin, func() {
		t.list.InvalidateHeights()
	})
	t.mapper.Children = t.subagents.Children
	t.mapper.ChildrenByJob = t.subagents.ChildrenByJob
	t.actions = NewMessageActions(t)
	return t
}

// SelectedEntryForTest reports the list's selected entry index. Exported for
// tests only; production code drives the cursor through Actions.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SelectedEntryForTest() int {
	if t == nil {
		return -1
	}
	return t.list.Selected
}

// Actions exposes the message-action cursor.
func (t *TranscriptPane) Actions() *MessageActions {
	if t == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return t.actions
}

// SetAutoExpandToolOutput opens file-editing rows, so a diff is visible without
// a keypress. Read/grep and bash rows keep their compact collapsed forms either
// way. A row the user collapses still wins for the rest of the session.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SetAutoExpandToolOutput(v bool) {
	if t != nil {
		t.mapper.AutoExpand = v
	}
}

// SetChecklistFile points the Mapper at a project task file. The row appears
// only while the file exists and holds at least one checklist item, so calling
// this before anything is written is safe.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SetChecklistFile(path string) {
	if t == nil || t.mapper == nil {
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
		t.mapper.Checklist = nil
		return
	}
	t.mapper.Checklist = NewChecklistSource(path)
}

// SetUsageCallback fires when an assistant message reports token usage.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SetUsageCallback(fn func(session.TokenUsage)) {
	if t != nil {
		t.onUsage = fn
	}
}

// SetCopyHandlers wires clipboard copy; feedback toasts go through the bus.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SetCopyHandlers(
	bus *controller.Bus,
	copyFn func(text string) bool,
) {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	t.copyFn = copyFn
	t.bus = bus
}

// Snapshot returns the current session model (read-only use on UI goroutine).
func (t *TranscriptPane) Snapshot() session.Snapshot {
	if t == nil {
		return session.Snapshot{}
	}
	return t.snap
}

// IsStreaming reports whether the agent stream is in flight.
func (t *TranscriptPane) IsStreaming() bool {
	if t == nil {
		return false
	}
	return session.IsStreaming(t.snap)
}

// IsEmpty reports whether the transcript has no committed entries.
func (t *TranscriptPane) IsEmpty() bool {
	if t == nil {
		return true
	}
	return len(t.list.Entries) == 0
}

// LastCopyText returns copy text for the last message block.
func (t *TranscriptPane) LastCopyText() string {
	if t == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return t.list.LastCopyText()
}

// AtBottom reports whether the list is pinned to the latest content.
func (t *TranscriptPane) AtBottom() bool {
	if t == nil {
		return true
	}
	return t.list.ScrollFromBottom == 0
}

// StickToBottom scrolls the list to the latest content.
func (t *TranscriptPane) StickToBottom() {
	if t != nil {
		t.list.StickToBottom()
	}
}

// ListHeight is the last drawn transcript area height (for picker anchoring).
func (t *TranscriptPane) ListHeight() int {
	if t == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return t.listH
}

// SelectionActive reports whether a drag-selection highlight is shown.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SelectionActive() bool {
	return t != nil && t.sel.active
}

// ClearSelection clears transcript text selection state.
func (t *TranscriptPane) ClearSelection() {
	if t != nil {
		t.sel.clear()
	}
}

// ApplySession applies one session event on the UI goroutine.
func (t *TranscriptPane) ApplySession(ev session.Event) {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	t.snap = session.Apply(t.snap, ev)
	if upd, ok := ev.(session.AssistantMessageUpdate); ok && upd.Message.Usage.Reported() && t.onUsage != nil {
		t.onUsage(upd.Message.Usage)
	}
	if td, ok := ev.(session.ToolData); ok {
		t.applyAgentToolData(td)
	}
}

// ApplyJobProgress updates nested sub-agent rows. Returns true when sync is needed.
func (t *TranscriptPane) ApplyJobProgress(p job.Progress) bool {
	if t == nil || t.subagents == nil {
		return false
	}
	return t.subagents.ApplyProgress(p)
}

// Entries exposes the projected widgets. Read-only: callers use it to assert on
// what the transcript currently shows without driving a full draw cycle.
func (t *TranscriptPane) Entries() []components.Widget {
	if t == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return t.list.Entries
}

// EntryIDs exposes the projected ids in order, parallel to Entries.
func (t *TranscriptPane) EntryIDs() []string {
	if t == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return t.listIDs
}

// Sync rebuilds transcript widgets from snap.
func (t *TranscriptPane) Sync() {
	if t == nil || t.mapper == nil {
		return
	}
	oldIDs := t.listIDs
	entries, ids, dirty := t.mapper.Sync(t.list.Entries, t.listIDs, t.snap)
	// A rebuild moves every entry, so a cursor sitting on an index would point
	// at a different block after the sync. Exit rather than silently retarget.
	if t.actions != nil && t.actions.Active && !sameIDSet(oldIDs, ids) {
		t.actions.Exit()
	}
	t.list.ReindexHeights(oldIDs, ids)
	t.list.Entries = entries
	t.listIDs = ids
	t.list.InvalidateHeightsAt(dirty...)
}

// sameIDSet reports whether two id lists hold the same entries in the same
// order. Order matters: the cursor is an index, not a set membership.
func sameIDSet(a, b []string) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range a {
		if a[i] != b[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// LoadReplay replaces snap and clears widget cache after ctrl replay.
func (t *TranscriptPane) LoadReplay(snap session.Snapshot) {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	t.snap = snap
	t.list.Entries = nil
	t.listIDs = nil
	t.list.InvalidateHeights()
}

// ResetSubagents clears nested job UI state (e.g. after /clear).
func (t *TranscriptPane) ResetSubagents() {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	t.subagents = NewSubagentStore()
	if t.mapper != nil {
		t.mapper.Children = t.subagents.Children
		t.mapper.ChildrenByJob = t.subagents.ChildrenByJob
	}
}

// SetTheme updates transcript chrome and existing widgets.
func (t *TranscriptPane) SetTheme(th components.Theme) {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	t.theme = th
	t.welcome.Theme = th
	t.list.Theme = th
	if t.mapper != nil {
		t.mapper.SetTheme(th)
	}
	applyThemeToWidgets(t.list.Entries, th)
	t.list.InvalidateHeights()
}

// Draw renders the transcript or welcome screen into listH.
func (t *TranscriptPane) Draw(ctx components.DrawContext, width, height int) components.Surface {
	if t == nil {
		return components.Surface{}
	}
	t.listH = height
	if t.welcome.Sphere != nil {
		t.welcome.Sphere.Time = time.Since(t.startedAt).Seconds()
	}
	constraints := ctx.WithConstraints(components.Size{}, components.Size{Width: width, Height: height})
	var listSurf components.Surface
	if len(t.list.Entries) == 0 {
		listSurf = t.welcome.Draw(constraints)
	} else {
		listSurf = t.list.Draw(constraints)
	}
	if t.sel.active {
		hl := t.theme.SelectionBg
		hl.Fg = t.theme.SelectionFg.Fg
		ax, ay, ex, ey := t.viewSel()
		components.ApplySelectionHighlight(&listSurf, ax, ay, ex, ey, hl)
	}
	t.lastListSurf = listSurf
	return listSurf
}

// HandlePageKey forwards page up/down to the message list.
func (t *TranscriptPane) HandlePageKey(ctx *components.EventContext, ev xui.KeyEvent) {
	if t != nil {
		t.list.Handle(ctx, ev)
	}
}

// HandleCopyKey handles copy chords over the transcript.
func (t *TranscriptPane) HandleCopyKey(ctx *components.EventContext, e xui.KeyEvent) bool {
	if t == nil || !e.Press {
		return false
	}
	copyChord := false
	if e.Code == xui.KeyRune && (e.Rune == 'c' || e.Rune == 'C') {
		if e.Mods.Has(xui.ModCtrl) && e.Mods.Has(xui.ModShift) {
			copyChord = true
		}
		if e.Mods.Has(xui.ModSuper) && !e.Mods.Has(xui.ModCtrl) {
			copyChord = true
		}
	}
	if !copyChord {
		return false
	}
	text := t.list.SelectedCopyText()
	if text == "" {
		text = t.list.LastCopyText()
	}
	if text == "" {
		return true
	}
	t.copyBlock(text)
	ctx.ConsumeAndRedraw()
	return true
}

// HandleMouse handles wheel, drag-selection, and block selection over the list.
func (t *TranscriptPane) HandleMouse(ctx *components.EventContext, e xui.MouseEvent, focusComposer func()) {
	if t == nil {
		return
	}
	if e.Button == xui.MouseWheelUp || e.Button == xui.MouseWheelDown {
		t.list.Handle(ctx, e)
		return
	}
	if e.Button != xui.MouseLeft && e.Button != 0 {
		if e.Action != xui.MouseMotion && e.Action != xui.MouseDrag {
			return
		}
	}

	inList := e.Y >= 0 && e.Y < t.listH && t.listH > 0 && len(t.list.Entries) > 0

	switch e.Action {
	case xui.MousePress:
		if e.Button != xui.MouseLeft {
			return
		}
		if !inList {
			t.sel.clear()
			ctx.Redraw = true
			return
		}
		cy := t.toContentY(e.Y)
		t.sel = textSel{
			pending: true,
			ax:      e.X,
			ay:      cy,
			ex:      e.X,
			ey:      cy,
		}
		if focusComposer != nil {
			focusComposer()
		}
		ctx.Redraw = true
		return

	case xui.MouseDrag, xui.MouseMotion:
		if !t.sel.pending && !t.sel.dragging {
			return
		}
		if e.Action == xui.MouseMotion && e.Button != xui.MouseLeft {
			return
		}
		t.sel.dragging = true
		t.sel.active = true
		t.sel.ex = e.X
		t.sel.ey = t.toContentY(e.Y)
		ctx.ConsumeAndRedraw()
		return

	case xui.MouseRelease:
		if e.Button != xui.MouseLeft {
			return
		}
		if !t.sel.pending && !t.sel.dragging {
			return
		}
		t.sel.ex = e.X
		t.sel.ey = t.toContentY(e.Y)
		if t.sel.dragging && (t.sel.ax != t.sel.ex || t.sel.ay != t.sel.ey) {
			ax, ay, ex, ey := t.viewSel()
			text := components.ExtractSurfaceText(t.lastListSurf, ax, ay, ex, ey)
			t.sel.active = true
			if text != "" {
				t.copyResult(text, "Selection copied to clipboard", "Failed to copy selection")
			}
			t.sel.pending = false
			t.sel.dragging = false
			ctx.ConsumeAndRedraw()
			return
		}
		idx := t.list.IndexAtPoint(e.X, e.Y)
		if idx >= 0 {
			t.list.Selected = idx
		}
		t.sel.clear()
		if focusComposer != nil {
			focusComposer()
		}
		ctx.ConsumeAndRedraw()
	}
}

func (t *TranscriptPane) applyAgentToolData(td session.ToolData) {
	name := strings.ToLower(td.Run.Name)
	switch name {
	case "agent_spawn", "agent_wait":
	default:
		return
	}
	parsed := tools.ParseAgentResult(td.Run.Output)
	if !parsed.OK {
		return
	}
	t.subagents.Bind(parsed.JobID, td.Run.ToolUseID)
	t.subagents.ApplyResult(td.Run.ToolUseID, parsed)
}

func (t *TranscriptPane) viewSel() (ax, ay, ex, ey int) {
	ox := t.list.ContentOrigin()
	return t.sel.ax, t.sel.ay + ox, t.sel.ex, t.sel.ey + ox
}

func (t *TranscriptPane) toContentY(viewY int) int {
	return viewY - t.list.ContentOrigin()
}

func (t *TranscriptPane) copyResult(text, okMsg, failMsg string) {
	if text == "" {
		return
	}
	ok := t.copyFn != nil && t.copyFn(text)
	if ok {
		t.bus.Publish(controller.ToastMsg{Message: okMsg, Kind: toast.ToastSuccess, Duration: 2 * time.Second})
	} else {
		t.bus.Publish(controller.ToastMsg{Message: failMsg, Kind: toast.ToastError, Duration: 2 * time.Second})
	}
}

// CopyBlock copies text to the clipboard with user feedback.
func (t *TranscriptPane) CopyBlock(text string) {
	t.copyBlock(text)
}

func (t *TranscriptPane) copyBlock(text string) {
	t.copyResult(text, "Copied to clipboard", "Failed to copy")
}

func applyThemeToWidgets(entries []components.Widget, th components.Theme) {
	for _, w := range entries {
		switch b := w.(type) {
		case *block.UserBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		case *block.AssistantBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		case *block.ThinkingBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		case *block.CompactionBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		case *block.ToolBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		case *block.BashBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		case *block.AgentBlock:
			b.Theme = th
		}
	}
}

	assert.ErrorIs(t, CopyText("   "), ErrEmpty)
}

}

func TestEncodeWindowsClipboardTextPreservesUnicode(t *testing.T) {
	want := "你好世界\n中文 + English\nemoji 😀🚀\né ñ ü\n多行\n文本"

	got, err := encodeWindowsClipboardText(want)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEmpty(t, got)

// Package clipboard reads and writes the system clipboard (plain text and images).
//
// Image reads use platform tools: wl-paste / xclip on Linux, osascript or
// pngpaste on macOS, PowerShell on Windows, with a WSL fallback to the Windows
// clipboard when Linux tools see no image data.
package clipboard
package clipboard

import "errors"

var (
	// ErrEmpty means the clipboard holds no usable content for the requested kind.
	ErrEmpty = errors.New("clipboard: empty")
	// ErrUnavailable means no image is present or required platform tools are missing.
	ErrUnavailable = errors.New("clipboard: unavailable")
)
package clipboard

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"time"
)

const (
	defaultListTimeout = time.Second
	defaultReadTimeout = 3 * time.Second
	defaultMaxBytes    = 50 << 20 // clipboard read cap before image.MaxBytes trim
)

func lookPath(name string) bool {
	_, err := exec.LookPath(name)
	return err == nil
}

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, name string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("clipboard: %s: %w", name, err)
	}
	out := stdout.Bytes()
	if len(out) > defaultMaxBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("clipboard: %s: output too large (%d bytes)", name, len(out))
	}
	return out, nil
}

//nolint:unparam // linux/WSL probes pass defaultListTimeout for list reads, 5s for PowerShell
func runCommandTimeout(timeout time.Duration, name string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
	defer cancel()
	return runCommand(ctx, name, args...)
}

func pipeToCommand(name string, data []byte, args ...string) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), defaultReadTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
	stdin, err := cmd.StdinPipe()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		_ = stdin.Close()
		return err
	}
	if _, err := stdin.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = stdin.Close()
		_ = cmd.Wait()
		return err
	}
	if err := stdin.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = cmd.Wait()
		return err
	}
	return cmd.Wait()
}
package clipboard

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/util"
)

// splitLines splits on LF (normalizing CRLF) and drops empty lines.
func splitLines(s string) []string {
	s = util.ReplaceAll(s, "\r\n", "\n")
	if s == "" {
		return nil
	}
	raw := strings.Split(s, "\n")
	out := make([]string, 0, len(raw))
	for _, line := range raw {
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if line != "" {
			out = append(out, line)
		}
	}
	return out
}

package clipboard

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func readClipboardImagePlatform() (Image, error) {
	if lookPath("pngpaste") {
		if img, err := readClipboardImageViaPNGPaste(); err == nil {
			return img, nil
		}
	}
	return readClipboardImageViaOsascript()
}

func readClipboardImageViaPNGPaste() (Image, error) {
	tmpFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "a1-clip-*.png")
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	path := tmpFile.Name()
	_ = tmpFile.Close()
	defer os.Remove(path)

	if _, err := runCommandTimeout(defaultReadTimeout, "pngpaste", path); err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return Image{Data: data, MimeType: "image/png"}, nil
}

func readClipboardImageViaOsascript() (Image, error) {
	tmpFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "a1-clip-*.png")
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	path := tmpFile.Name()
	_ = tmpFile.Close()
	defer os.Remove(path)

	script := fmt.Sprintf(`try
  set pngData to the clipboard as «class PNGf»
  if pngData is missing value then return "empty"
  set f to open for access POSIX file %q with write permission
  write pngData to f
  close access f
  return "ok"
on error
  return "empty"
end try`, path)
	out, err := runCommandTimeout(defaultReadTimeout, "osascript", "-e", script)
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(out)) != "ok" {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return Image{Data: data, MimeType: "image/png"}, nil
}
package clipboard

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	imgutil "github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/util/image"
)

// Image is raw image data from the clipboard plus a MIME type.
type Image struct {
	Data     []byte
	MimeType string
}

// ReadImage returns image bytes from the clipboard when available.
func ReadImage() (Image, error) {
	img, err := readClipboardImagePlatform()
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, err
	}
	if len(img.Data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	mime := baseMimeType(img.MimeType)
	if mime == "" {
		mime = http.DetectContentType(img.Data)
	}
	if !isSupportedImageMimeType(mime) {
		return Image{}, fmt.Errorf("clipboard: unsupported image type %q", mime)
	}
	if len(img.Data) > imgutil.MaxBytes {
		return Image{}, fmt.Errorf("clipboard: image too large: %d bytes (max %d)", len(img.Data), imgutil.MaxBytes)
	}
	return Image{Data: img.Data, MimeType: mime}, nil
}

// ReadImageResult validates clipboard image bytes the same way as image.Load.
func ReadImageResult() (imgutil.Result, error) {
	img, err := ReadImage()
	if err != nil {
		return imgutil.Result{}, err
	}
	mime := http.DetectContentType(img.Data)
	if !isSupportedImageMimeType(mime) {
		return imgutil.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("clipboard: unsupported image type %q (want png, jpeg, gif, or webp)", mime)
	}
	return imgutil.Result{Data: img.Data, MimeType: mime}, nil
}
//go:build linux

package clipboard

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/damien1141/a1/internal/util"
)

func isWaylandSession() bool {
	return os.Getenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY") != "" || os.Getenv("XDG_SESSION_TYPE") == "wayland"
}

func readClipboardImagePlatform() (Image, error) {
	if os.Getenv("TERMUX_VERSION") != "" {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}

	wayland := isWaylandSession()
	wsl := isWSL()

	if wayland || wsl {
		if img, ok := tryReadImage(readClipboardImageViaWlPaste); ok {
			return img, nil
		}
		if img, ok := tryReadImage(readClipboardImageViaXclip); ok {
			return img, nil
		}
	}
	if wsl {
		if img, ok := tryReadImage(readClipboardImageViaPowerShell); ok {
			return img, nil
		}
	}
	if !wayland {
		if img, ok := tryReadImage(readClipboardImageViaXclip); ok {
			return img, nil
		}
	}
	return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
}

func tryReadImage(read func() (Image, error)) (Image, bool) {
	img, err := read()
	if err != nil || len(img.Data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, false
	}
	return img, true
}

func readClipboardImageViaWlPaste() (Image, error) {
	typesOut, err := runCommandTimeout(defaultListTimeout, "wl-paste", "--list-types")
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	selected := selectPreferredImageMimeType(splitLines(string(typesOut)))
	if selected == "" {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	data, err := runCommandTimeout(defaultReadTimeout, "wl-paste", "--type", selected, "--no-newline")
	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return Image{Data: data, MimeType: baseMimeType(selected)}, nil
}

func readClipboardImageViaXclip() (Image, error) {
	var candidateTypes []string
	if targets, err := runCommandTimeout(
		defaultListTimeout,
		"xclip",
		"-selection",
		"clipboard",
		"-t",
		"TARGETS",
		"-o",
	); err == nil {
		candidateTypes = splitLines(string(targets))
	}

	preferred := selectPreferredImageMimeType(candidateTypes)
	tryTypes := append([]string(nil), preferredImageMimes...)
	if preferred != "" {
		tryTypes = append([]string{preferred}, tryTypes...)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tryTypes))
	for _, mimeType := range tryTypes {
		mimeType = baseMimeType(mimeType)
		if mimeType == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[mimeType]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[mimeType] = struct{}{}
		data, err := runCommandTimeout(defaultReadTimeout, "xclip", "-selection", "clipboard", "-t", mimeType, "-o")
		if err == nil && len(data) > 0 {
			return Image{Data: data, MimeType: mimeType}, nil
		}
	}
	return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
}

func readClipboardImageViaPowerShell() (Image, error) {
	tmpFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "a1-wsl-clip-*.png")
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	path := tmpFile.Name()
	_ = tmpFile.Close()
	defer os.Remove(path)

	winPath, err := runCommandTimeout(defaultListTimeout, "wslpath", "-w", path)
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	winPathStr := strings.TrimSpace(string(winPath))
	if winPathStr == "" {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}

	psQuoted := util.ReplaceAll(winPathStr, "'", "''")
	psScript := fmt.Sprintf(
		"Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; "+
			"$path = '%s'; $img = [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetImage(); "+
			"if ($img) { $img.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png); Write-Output 'ok' } else { Write-Output 'empty' }",
		psQuoted,
	)
	out, err := runCommandTimeout(5*time.Second, "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", psScript)
	if err != nil {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(out)) != "ok" {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return Image{Data: data, MimeType: "image/png"}, nil
}

func isWSL() bool {
	if os.Getenv("WSL_DISTRO_NAME") != "" || os.Getenv("WSLENV") != "" {
		return true
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/version")
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return bytes.Contains(bytes.ToLower(data), []byte("microsoft")) ||
		bytes.Contains(bytes.ToLower(data), []byte("wsl"))
}

func readClipboardImagePlatform() (Image, error) {

		"if ($img) { $img.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png); Write-Output 'ok' } else { Write-Output 'empty' }"

	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
		return Image{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return Image{Data: data, MimeType: "image/png"}, nil
}
package clipboard

import (
	"slices"
	"strings"
)

var preferredImageMimes = []string{
	"image/png",
	"image/jpeg",
	"image/webp",
	"image/gif",
}

func baseMimeType(mimeType string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(mimeType, ";")[0]))
}

func selectPreferredImageMimeType(types []string) string {
	normalized := make([]struct{ raw, base string }, 0, len(types))
	for _, t := range types {
		t = strings.TrimSpace(t)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		normalized = append(normalized, struct{ raw, base string }{raw: t, base: baseMimeType(t)})
	}
	for _, preferred := range preferredImageMimes {
		for _, t := range normalized {
			if t.base == preferred {
				return t.raw
			}
		}
	}
	for _, t := range normalized {
		if strings.HasPrefix(t.base, "image/") {
			return t.raw
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func isSupportedImageMimeType(mimeType string) bool {
	return slices.Contains(preferredImageMimes, baseMimeType(mimeType))
}

// ExtensionForImageMimeType maps a MIME type to a common file extension.
func ExtensionForImageMimeType(mimeType string) string {
	switch baseMimeType(mimeType) {
	case "image/png":
		return "png"
	case "image/jpeg":
		return "jpg"
	case "image/webp":
		return "webp"
	case "image/gif":
		return "gif"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}
package clipboard

import (
	"errors"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
)

// CopyText writes plain text to the system clipboard.
func CopyText(text string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(text) == "" {
		return ErrEmpty
	}
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "darwin":
		return pipeToCommand("pbcopy", []byte(text))
	case "windows":
		return copyTextWindows(text)
	default:
		if lookPath("wl-copy") {
			if err := pipeToCommand("wl-copy", []byte(text)); err == nil {
				return nil
			}
		}
		if lookPath("xclip") {
			return pipeToCommand("xclip", []byte(text), "-selection", "clipboard")
		}
		return errors.New("clipboard: copy text: install wl-clipboard or xclip")
	}
}
